Package com.j3d.engine.interact.macros

Class MacroRunner

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.macros.MacroRunner
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener
public class MacroRunner extends Object implements EventListener
A single-instantiated class with the purpose of running a single Macro with many responsibilities

A typical flow is:

  1. Read one macro off the queue
  2. Execute it
  3. Repeat
However, in the case of Macro with an instruction type of InstructionType.COMMAND_EXEC, the executed command might be stateful (implement SemiStatefulCommand), meaning it may have not finished synchronously. In that case the order is as follows:
  1. Read one macro off the queue
  2. Execute it
  3. Check if it was a command and it is stateful

    • If yes : Exit early and instead only continue if we receive the EventType.STATEFUL_COMMAND_COMPLETED event from Commands which denotes the command has completed, then repeat.
    • If no : Repeat as normal

This class can be accessed via MacroUtils however should only be sued by MacroCmd (specifically its recording subcommand RunCmd)

    • commandLine

      private boolean commandLine(String line)
      Execute a given command-line by stealing what the command parser itself thinks the parsed arguments would be.
      Parameters:
      line - The input line
      Returns:
      true indicating that the next macro instruction invocation can be polled via poll() otherwise false indicating that expectEvent is now true hence the next invocation will only happen once the event has been emitted.
